title: House Clearance & Bereavement Services Birmingham
metaTitle: House Clearance Birmingham & West Midlands | Licensed & Compassionate
metaDescription: Licensed, compassionate house clearance and probate services in Birmingham and the Black Country. Full property clearances, ethical recycling and donation.
heroSubheading: Licensed house clearance in Birmingham and the West Midlands for probate, bereavement, downsizing and end of tenancy. As a registered Environment Agency waste carrier, we clear every room, loft and shed, donate usable items to local charities and provide a Waste Transfer Note for every job.
summary: Handling probate, decluttering before moving house, or preparing a property for sale? Jimmys Removals holds a registered Environment Agency Waste Carrier Licence to provide responsible, fully licensed house clearances across Birmingham and the West Midlands. Our respectful movers clear furniture, electrical appliances, garage clutter, and household bric-a-brac, prioritizing donations to local charities and responsible recycling to keep usable goods out of landfill while providing legal waste transfer documentation.
benefits: Environment Agency registered Upper Tier Waste Carrier
Over 85% of cleared materials diverted from landfill via donation and recycling
Respectful, discreet, and patient handling of probate and bereavement estates
Clear itemised paperwork and waste transfer notes provided for solicitors
Complete sweep-clean of cleared rooms, garages, lofts, and outbuildings

process.title: Property Walkthrough & Estimate
process.description: We conduct an on-site or video appraisal of items to be retained, donated, recycled, or disposed of, providing a firm fixed quotation.

process.title: Sentimental Item Segregation
process.description: Any family photographs, legal papers, or sentimental heirlooms discovered during clearance are carefully set aside for your inspection.

process.title: Systematic Clearing & Loading
process.description: Our team clears furniture, white goods, textiles, and miscellaneous contents from the house, cellar, and garden sheds.

process.title: Donation, Recycling & Sweep
process.description: Usable items are delivered to West Midlands partner charities, recyclables to licensed stations, and rooms are left swept clean.

whatsIncluded: Full property clearance (including lofts, basements, and sheds)
Environment Agency legal Duty of Care Waste Transfer Note
Transportation of donated goods to certified charity partners
Sorting, bagging, lifting, and heavy appliance removal
Post-clearance broom sweep of all cleared spaces
whatsNotIncluded: Removal of hazardous asbestos or chemical pesticide drums
Structural demolition of masonry outbuildings or walls
Commercial trade demolition rubble beyond domestic DIY quantities
priceNotes: Achievable starting price for a single room, garage, or partial flat clearance with reusable items offset.

faqs.question: Are you a licensed waste carrier?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jimmys Removals and Logistics LTD holds a valid Environment Agency Waste Carrier licence. We supply official Waste Transfer Notes for every clearance job.

faqs.question: Do I need to be present throughout the clearance?
faqs.answer: No. Many clients and estate executors prefer to grant key access or leave keys with an estate agent. We can photograph the completed swept property and lock up securely.

faqs.question: What happens to furniture that is still in good condition?
faqs.answer: We partner with reputable charitable organisations across Birmingham to donate clean, fire-labelled furniture, helping families in need while avoiding landfill.

faqs.question: Can you clear overgrown gardens, sheds, and garages too?
faqs.answer: Yes. We clear outdoor sheds, garages, workshops, and greenhouse contents alongside the main domestic residence.
